title: determinism_log.gd dereferences unguarded load() results and has no error-exit before quit()
detail: If the shared-const script fails to load, .REPLAY_CMDS dereferences null and _go aborts with a script error before any quit() call — the headless SceneTree mainloop never exits, so the README verify command hangs instead of returning nonzero.
recommended_fix: Guard both loads: if null, printerr and quit(1) before touching REPLAY_CMDS/REPLAY_TICKS.

title: house_pair_extremes indexes houses[0]/houses[1] with no size guard
evidence:
var longest := [houses[0], houses[1]]
	var shortest := [houses[0], houses[1]]
detail: A placement set with fewer than two houses reaches out-of-bounds indexing, aborting the whole coroutine instead of recording a failed check; no guard exists in the changed lines.
recommended_fix: Check houses.size() >= 2 first and fail via check(false, ...) with an early return.

title: test_editor_preview dereferences instantiate() and get_node() results without null guards
detail: The load-null path is guarded but instantiate-null is not, and get_node("Planet")/get_node("Nodes") results are dereferenced unguarded; a failed instantiation or renamed node aborts the coroutine.
recommended_fix: Mirror the load guard: check scene != null and non-null planet/sites before add_child and _staging dereferences.

title: test_view_interaction dereferences null-returning request_connect/bundle_for_pair without guards
detail: main.request_connect returns null when sim is null or the bundle lookup fails (main.gd 'return null'), and SimCore.bundle_for_pair returns null for unknown pairs (sim_core.gd 'return null'); both null returns are dereferenced (.id, .sample_at) with no guard, as is main.get("sim").
recommended_fix: Null-check arc, sim, and the bundle result; record check(false, ...) and bail before .id/.sample_at use.

title: drops[0] indexed immediately after non-halting checks
evidence:
check(int(sim.dropped_total) == 1, "precedence: exactly one packet dropped on the forced overflow")
	check(str(sim.drops[0].cls) == "email", "precedence: the email is the victim of an all-streaming queue")
detail: check() records failure but does not halt, so a zero-drop regression (exactly the divergence these pins exist to catch) indexes drops[0] on an empty array — coroutine abort instead of a labeled check failure. Same pattern at test_sim_qos.gd:117 and test_sim_sla.gd:115.
recommended_fix: Guard each drops[0] access with sim.drops.size() > 0 or fold the field read into a short-circuited check expression.

title: payload[0] and pool[0] indexed without size guards after non-halting checks
evidence:
check(payload.size() == 1, "panel: Apply emits exactly one payload")
	var pl: Array = payload[0] ... check(pool[0].visible and pool[0].material_override == email_mat,
detail: A regression emitting zero apply payloads or admitting no dots leaves payload/pool empty; the unguarded indices abort the coroutine. Line 185's pool[0] is short-circuit-guarded by pool.size() >= 2; lines 140 and 193 have no such guard.
recommended_fix: Add payload.size() >= 1 and pool.size() >= 1 guards, or fold the indexing into the same short-circuited check expressions.

title: panel payload validation loop is vacuous when a class is missing from cls
detail: The mirror-validation iterates only classes present in the payload; sim_core.gd:159 rejects payloads missing a class key ('if not cls_lane.has(cls): return'), so an empty/partial cls dict passes this check while the sim would no-op it.
recommended_fix: Also assert cls.size() == SimBalance.CLASS_IDS.size() (both classes present) before the loop.
